fall_1.japanese: ああ…やっと秋が来た！$h#$e#夏には ウンザリしていたわ！

fall_Thu10.japanese: 昨晩見た夢に あなたが 出てきた。#$e#面白くて、 良い夢だったわ。$h
fall_Thu10.english: You appeared in a dream I had last night.#$e#It was an interesting, good dream.

fall_Tue.japanese: $d joja#いつもお店で手伝いをしてるわ。Jojaマートが 開店してから 売り上げは ガタ落ちだけどね。| Jojaマートが 閉店して以来、 景気は上々よ！$h

fall_Tue4.japanese: 両親とは よくケンカするけど、あたしのことが心配なのはわかってる。最善だと 思っていることを やってるだけなのよ。$s#$b#でも、どうして あなたに こんなことを 話してるのかしら。絶対誰にも 言わないでよ。$8
fall_Tue4.english: I often fight with my parents, but I understand that they worry about me. They're just doing what they think is best.#But why am I telling you this, I wonder. Absolutely don't tell anyone.

fall_Wed.japanese: 今年も はやく カボチャが 見たい。$h#$e#スピリットイブは 季節の 終わりに 開催されるの。ズズシティのものと 比べたら 結構 地味なんだけど、 この小さな町じゃ すごく 楽しい祭りなのよ。
fall_Wed.english: I want to see pumpkins soon this year too.#Spirit's Eve is held at the end of the season. Compared to Zuzu City's it's pretty plain, but in this small town it's a really fun festival.

fall_Wed2.japanese: 今年は牧場で カボチャを育てているの？#$e# 1つ、あたしのためにとっておいて！$h
fall_Wed2.english: Are you growing pumpkins at the farm this year?# Save one for me!

married_Sam.japanese: あはは…サムが結婚したなんて信じられないわ。誰も思いもしなかったはずよ。$h#$e#冗談は置いといて、彼はいつか最高の父親になると思うわ。
married_Sam.english: Ahaha... I can't believe Sam got married. Nobody would have thought so.#Jokes aside, I think he'll be a great father someday.

mineArea_10_oneday.japanese: 古い鉱山を探検してるって聞いたわ。すごく楽しそうね！$h#$e#…私にもっと勇気があればあそこに行けるのにな…$s
mineArea_10_oneday.english: I heard you're exploring the old mine. It sounds really fun!#...If only I had more courage, I could go there too...

movieTheater.english: Do you know a new movie theater opened in town? I'm really looking forward to going to see it!

secondChance_Girls.english: Sigh... I can't stay angry like this forever, @. Let's seriously face our everyday lives.

spring_12.japanese: 明日のエッグハントには絶対に参加するけど、あなたはどう？
spring_12.english: I'm definitely joining tomorrow's egg hunt, but how about you?

spring_23.english: Come to think of it, tomorrow is the Flower Dance. Dancing is fine, but I hate being made to wear that lame white dress...

summer_10.english: Everyone seems unable to wait for tomorrow's festival. Since the governor is coming to town, they're probably a bit nervous though.

summer_27.japanese: 明日のお祭りは見逃せないよ。この谷で最も美しくて、ステキなものだからね。
summer_27.english: You can't miss tomorrow's festival. Because it's the most beautiful, wonderful thing in this valley.

summer_6.japanese: 昨晩、 暗くなってから海へ行ったの…変な光が 海の上に 浮かんでるのを 時たま見るのよ。#$e# たぶん 夢を見てたのかも しれないけど…現実味が なかったからね。

summer_Fri.japanese: ネコを飼いたかった。でも、 パパは アレルギー持ち だから無理なのよ。
summer_Fri.english: I wanted to have a cat. But Dad has allergies, so it's impossible.

summer_Fri10.japanese: 牧場で一人暮らしって、 さびしくなったりしない？
summer_Fri10.english: Living alone on the farm, don't you get lonely?

summer_Mon.japanese: 飼ってる モルモットの ダビデも、 暑い日は大嫌いでね。騒がしくしてるわ。

summer_Mon8.english: I always thought Pelican Town was a boring place until now, but lately I've come to like it.

summer_Sat.japanese: 早く秋に なってくれないかな… 涼しい山の風、 渦巻いて落ちる紅葉、 キノコの香り… はぁ。
summer_Sat.english: I wish fall would come soon... the cool mountain wind, the swirling falling autumn leaves, the scent of mushrooms... sigh.

summer_Sat6.japanese: 本当のところ、 今年の夏は 楽しめてるの。$h#$e# 物事の見方が こんなに早く かわるなんて変かな。
summer_Sat6.english: Truthfully, I'm enjoying this summer.# Is it strange that how I see things changes so quickly?

summer_Thu4.english: Ugh, I don't want to get a tan this summer.
